table.retrieve:
SELECT invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
         date        = dbo.saleledger.date,    
         ref1= max(dbo.saleledger.custrefno),
			ref2= max(dbo.saleledger.custrefno2),
			ref3= max(dbo.saleledger.custrefno3),
			remarks=max(dbo.saleledger.remarks),
			doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
         dbo.accounts.name, 
			totalamount=Isnull(Round(SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
	 						SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
	    						(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
	 						Round( (sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
	    						(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) - saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
	 						Round( sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
	    							(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + saleledger.misccharges  + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
    FROM dbo.saleledger, 
         dbo.saledetail,   
         dbo.accounts

   WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) and 
			( dbo.saleledger.custcode = :ai_custcode) and
         ( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
			
     	   ( dbo.saleledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            

GROUP BY dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         dbo.saleledger.date,   
         dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
			dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
			dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
			dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1 ,
			dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
			dbo.accounts.name
UNION ALL
  SELECT invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
         date        = dbo.saleledger.date,    
         ref1= max(dbo.saleledger.custrefno),
			ref2= max(dbo.saleledger.custrefno2),
			ref3= max(dbo.saleledger.custrefno3),
			remarks=max(dbo.saleledger.remarks),
			doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
         dbo.accounts.name, 
			totalamount=Isnull(Round(SUM(sd.looseqty * sd.unitsalestax) + 
	 						SUM(ROUND( (sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) *
	    						(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc)) * sd.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
	 						Round( (sum( (sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) *
	    						(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) - saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
	 						Round( sum( (sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) *
	    							(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + saleledger.misccharges  + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)
    FROM dbo.saleledger, 
         dbo.saleinvdetail sd,
         dbo.accounts

   WHERE ( DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' ) AND
			( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode ) and 
			( dbo.saleledger.custcode = :ai_custcode) and
         ( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
			( dbo.saleledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            

GROUP BY dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         dbo.saleledger.date,   
         dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
			dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
			dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
			dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1 ,
			dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
			dbo.accounts.name
ORDER BY dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode ASC,   
         dbo.saleledger.date ASC
table.sort: remarks A, ref3 A, ref2 A, ref1 A
